counter_score_rules.ash_only: 1 if volcano alert is Green/Orange and lava_flow_covered_area is false else 0
counter_score_rules.earthquake_only: 2 if eq_mw >= 6.5 and eruptive_fissures_opened is false else 0

criteria.name: Answer shape
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, flags, scores, answer, and one computed_consequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when the final label is present but one ledger block is incomplete.

criteria.name: Metric extraction
criteria.description: Extracts fissure length 6.8 km, lava area 35.5 sq km, minimum lava rate 100 m3/s, Mw 6.9 earthquake, summit-collapse Mw 4.7-5.4, and precipitation maximum 193.836 mm within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for at least four correct metrics with units or recognizable field names.

criteria.name: Integrated-score formula
criteria.description: Applies the integrated score formula exactly: 2*orange_alert + 2*200yr_scale + 2*lava_extent + 1*effusion + 1*quake + 1*collapse_energy + 1*summit_sequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for using the right gates but making one weight or arithmetic error.

criteria.name: Counter-score tests
criteria.description: Computes the counter scores as rainfall_context = 2, ash_only = 0, and earthquake_only = 0 using the defined tests.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for rejecting the counterlabels qualitatively while omitting one score.

criteria.name: Decision rule and label
criteria.description: Uses integrated_score >= 8 and integrated_score > max(counter_scores) to return integrated_lerz_lava_collapse_chain.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when the label is correct but the threshold comparison is not shown.

criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.description: States only the short consequence supported by the ledger: rainfall remains contextual while the coupled LERZ lava, summit-collapse, and earthquake chain dominates.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a concise event-specific consequence with one minor unsupported embellishment.

criteria.name: No overclaim
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported response advice, casualty/loss totals, road-closure claims, gas concentrations, ashfall depths, or treating the task as a broad disaster interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit for this item if the answer centers operational advice or uncomputed impacts.
